- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment periods (sentiment < 0.3) — increase forecast lows.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast peaks at 1–2% below true max in 30d horizon.
- Lagged mean reversion bias — if 18-day history shows strong trend, forecast should not overreact to short-term noise.
- Forecast should align with sentiment direction: if sentiment is rising, avoid downward bias; if falling, avoid upward bias.
- For 30d horizon, reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is flat or neutral (sentiment ~0.3–0.7).
- Correct for “sentiment echo” — if sentiment is high but price is flat, forecast should not overreact; if sentiment is low but price is rising, forecast should not underestimate.
